description: List tracked products. Your watchlist, newest first, with each product's latest state and its recent prices (trend). Filter with asin (and marketplace) to know if a product is tracked, or with filter to get the same lists as the app's tabs.

filter.description: Only the products of one of the app's watchlist filters. all: Every tracked product (default). drops: Cheaper now than when the product was added. target: At or below its target price. out_of_stock: No offer at the last check. attention: The last check didn't go through (last_error is set): no cred… Allowed values: all, drops, target, out_of_stock, attention, paused. Default: "all".

marketplace.description: Only this Amazon store Allowed values: com, co.uk, de, fr, it, es, ca, co.jp, com.br, com.mx, in.

name: list_products
title: List tracked products
